descriptions.feed_moment: Fetch the featured 'moment' card currently shown at the top of the signed-in user's Philonet feed. Read-only, takes no parameters, requires PHILONET_TOKEN. Returns the Moment object; use feed_suggested for a list of suggested curiosity sessions instead.
descriptions.friends_requests_preview: Preview pending friend requests for the signed-in Philonet user: a lightweight summary suited to a badge or digest. Read-only, no parameters, requires PHILONET_TOKEN. Returns a FriendRequestsPreview object; use friends_requests for the full list.
descriptions.friends_top: List the signed-in user's top friends on Philonet, the people they interact with most. Read-only, no parameters, requires PHILONET_TOKEN. Returns the Topfriend records.
descriptions.inbox_unread_conversations: Get unread discussion counters for the signed-in user's Philonet inbox, showing which conversations have new messages. Read-only, no parameters, requires PHILONET_TOKEN. Returns Unreadconversation counters; use inbox_discussions to read the threads themselves.
descriptions.me_awards: List the awards (stars) the signed-in user has received on their Philonet thoughts. Read-only, no parameters, requires PHILONET_TOKEN. Returns Myaward records; pair with me_standings for ranking context.
descriptions.me_bookmarks: List thoughts the signed-in user has bookmarked on Philonet. Read-only, no parameters, requires PHILONET_TOKEN. Returns Mybookmark records; use me_read_later for saved articles instead.
descriptions.me_engagements: List the signed-in user's recent engagements on Philonet. Read-only, no parameters, requires PHILONET_TOKEN. Returns Myengagement records.
descriptions.me_onboarding: Get the signed-in user's Philonet onboarding state and selected interests. Read-only, no parameters, requires PHILONET_TOKEN. Returns the Onboarding object; useful for personalising suggestions.
descriptions.me_read_later: List articles the signed-in user has saved to read later on Philonet. Read-only, no parameters, requires PHILONET_TOKEN. Returns Readlater records; use me_bookmarks for bookmarked thoughts instead.
descriptions.me_spotlights: List the signed-in user's Philonet spotlights. Read-only, no parameters, requires PHILONET_TOKEN. Returns Spotlightsnew records.
